faculty.name: Roberto Abreu
faculty.summary: Studies mental health outcomes among Latinx LGBTQ people and their families, focusing on systemic and relational factors, and experiences of trans youth.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔 LGBTQ 人群及其家庭的心理健康结果，关注系统和关系因素，以及跨性别青少年的经历。

faculty.name: Susan Bluck
faculty.summary: Studies how social interactions influence memory and autobiographical recall, using experimental and observational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会互动如何影响记忆和自传性回忆，使用实验和观察方法。

faculty.name: Brian Cahill
faculty.summary: Studies how social and cognitive processes influence legal decision-making, using empirical methods to investigate eyewitness and juror decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和认知过程如何影响法律决策，通过实证方法探讨目击者和陪审团的决策过程。

faculty.name: Ron Chandler
faculty.summary: Studies the role of human dignity in education and sustainability, promoting prosocial behavior and a sustainable human ecology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类尊严在教育和可持续性中的作用，促进亲社会行为和可持续的人类生态。

faculty.name: Shanting Chen
faculty.summary: Studies how socio-cultural and bio-behavioral factors influence adolescent development in the context of inequality, using longitudinal and ecological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会文化与生物行为因素如何影响不平等背景下青少年的发展，采用纵向和生态学方法。

faculty.name: Jonathan Chow
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of addiction and drug abuse using behavioral and cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾和药物滥用的神经机制，使用行为和认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Nicholas Coles
faculty.summary: Studies social influence on cognitive processes, focusing on how social context affects memory and decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会环境对认知过程的影响，重点关注社会情境如何影响记忆和决策。

faculty.name: Jesse Dallery
faculty.summary: Studies technology-based interventions for health behavior, decision making, and addiction using human laboratory experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基于技术的干预措施促进健康行为、决策制定和成瘾，使用人类实验室实验。

faculty.name: Iser DeLeon
faculty.summary: Studies the assessment and treatment of problem behavior in individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders, focusing on applied behavioral economics and individualized learning arrangements for.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍个体的问题行为评估与治疗，侧重于行为经济学和自闭症儿童的个性化学习安排。

faculty.name: Darragh Devine
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological basis of self-injurious behavior in animals, focusing on dopaminergic insufficiency and stress-responsive phenotypes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自伤行为的神经生物学基础，重点关注多巴胺不足和应激反应表型。

faculty.name: Nicole Dorey
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes in development, focusing on working memory and attention in children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程，重点是工作记忆和注意力的发展。

faculty.name: Ryan Duffy
faculty.summary: Studies counseling psychology and mental health interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究咨询心理学和心理健康干预。

faculty.name: Natalie Ebner
faculty.summary: Studies brain-behavior relationships in aging using MRI, eye-tracking, and real-life interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老化过程中的脑-行为关系，使用MRI、眼动追踪和现实生活干预方法。

faculty.name: W. Matt Friedl
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, using behavioral experiments and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用行为实验和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Julia Graber
faculty.summary: Studies child development, focusing on family and policy influences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童发展，重点关注家庭和政策的影响。

faculty.name: Nicole Gravina
faculty.summary: Studies organizational behavior management and employee well-being in healthcare settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织行为管理及医疗保健工作者的心理健康。

faculty.name: Corina Jimenez-Gomez
faculty.summary: Studies choice, decision making, and reinforcement processes in diverse learners, with a focus on cultural responsiveness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多样学习者的选择、决策和强化过程，并注重文化适应性。

faculty.name: Andreas Keil
faculty.summary: Studies emotion and attention using the Center for the Study of Emotion & Attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪与注意力，使用情绪与注意力研究中心的方法。
keywords: center for the study of emotion & attention

faculty.name: Shani Kerr
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Darlene Kertes
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of stress on health and development, focusing on life experiences and epigenetic processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力对健康和发展的影响，重点关注生活经历和表观遗传过程。

faculty.name: Taewon Kim
faculty.summary: Studies economic marginalization, suboptimal work, and its impact on mental health, using intersectional forces and subjective social mobility.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究经济边缘化、非理想工作及其对心理健康的影响，使用交叉力量和主观社会流动性。

faculty.name: Marina Klimenko
faculty.summary: Studies social and emotional development, focusing on morality, culture, and experiential learning in undergraduate research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和情绪发展，重点关注道德、文化和体验性学习。

faculty.name: Lori Knackstedt
faculty.summary: Studies the neuroadaptations in the glutamate system caused by chronic drug use and tests compounds to reduce drug-seeking behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾药物慢性使用引起的谷氨酸系统适应性变化，并测试减少觅药行为的化合物。

faculty.name: Faris Kronfli
faculty.summary: Develops social skills assessments and interventions for individuals with autism spectrum disorder, focusing on inclusive postsecondary education.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发自闭症谱系障碍个体的社会技能评估和干预措施，关注包容性高等教育。

faculty.name: Jose Martinez
faculty.summary: Studies social behavior and interactions, focusing on social psychology phenomena.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会行为和互动，侧重于社会心理学现象。

faculty.name: Ryan Mears
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral processes using neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知和行为过程，使用神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Bonnie Moradi
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of discrimination, prejudice, and objectification on health, work, education, and organizations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究歧视、偏见和物化对健康、工作、教育和组织的影响。

faculty.name: Brian Odegaard
faculty.summary: Studies attention, perception, and consciousness using computational models and machine learning, with a focus on human-LLM interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意、知觉和意识，使用计算模型和机器学习方法，重点关注人类与LLM的交互。

faculty.name: Billy Palmer
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior in counseling psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为在咨询心理学中的应用。

faculty.name: Rui Pei
faculty.summary: Studies how people navigate uncertain social situations, perceive others, and build social networks using surveys, experiments, and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何在不确定的社会环境中导航、感知他人并建立社会网络，使用调查、实验和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Chris Podlesnik
faculty.summary: Studies the role of fundamental conditioning processes in choice and behavior relapse, aiming to improve behavioral treatments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基本条件作用过程在选择和行为复燃中的作用，旨在改进行为治疗方法。

faculty.name: Lindsey Rodriguez
faculty.summary: Studies interventions for individuals and couples dealing with stressors like addictive behaviors and romantic conflict using experimental and longitudinal designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究针对应对成瘾行为和浪漫冲突等压力因素的个体和伴侣的干预措施，采用实验性和纵向设计。

faculty.name: Shari Schwartz
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes in development, focusing on memory and attention in children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童记忆和注意力的认知过程。

faculty.name: Marek Schwendt
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological underpinnings of drug addiction, focusing on mGluR5 receptor dysregulation and developing pharmacological interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾的神经生物学机制，重点关注mGluR5受体的失调及其新型药物干预措施的开发。
keywords: 多巴胺-谷氨酸-腺苷相互作用

faculty.name: Lisa Scott
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn and process faces and objects using EEG and eye-tracking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过EEG和眼动追踪学习和处理面孔和物体的认知发展。

faculty.name: Laura Shambaugh
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on how they learn and process information.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点在于他们如何学习和处理信息。

faculty.name: Yuki Shigemoto
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes in decision-making, using behavioral experiments and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程中的认知过程，使用行为实验和计算模型。

faculty.name: Colin Smith
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Tim Vollmer
faculty.summary: Studies applied behavior analysis, focusing on autism, intellectual disabilities, reinforcement schedules, and parenting.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应用行为分析，重点是自闭症、智力障碍、强化时间表和育儿。

faculty.name: Feihong Wang
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop cognitive skills, focusing on early learning and social interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知技能的发展，重点关注早期学习和社会互动。

faculty.name: Gregory Webster
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development and social cognition in children using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展和社会认知，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Erin Westgate
faculty.summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, focusing on social influence and attitudes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，重点关注社会影响和态度。
